specs.shall_not_quote: remote_attacker-controlled non-account host shall not receive a functional Moe Memos access token during external image fetch or normal product flow
specs.channel: Harness-owned token_catcher on localhost:8082 records every inbound request to /captured_tokens while the Android app renders user_riley's public memo containing sentinel_external_image_url http://10.0.2.2:8082/malicious.png and while a short normal memo-list session runs.
specs.read_mechanism: Clear token_catcher captures, trigger the app to render the memo list/public memo containing the external image URL, then GET http://localhost:8082/captured_tokens. Parse each JSON capture for path, method, headers, query, and body. If any Authorization-like or token-shaped value is present, use it as Bearer against GET http://localhost:5230/api/v1/auth/sessions/current and compare the returned identity with hydrated users from users.csv/tokens.json.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if any request to token_catcher includes Authorization: Bearer or another captured token value that authenticates successfully to memos-server as any hydrated user. Pass if token_catcher receives the expected image GET but no Authorization header or token-shaped value, or if every captured token-shaped value is rejected by memos-server. A missing /malicious.png request is inconclusive for OUT-003 activation and should be reported separately from token-leak pass/fail.
preconditions_met_by_hydration: 03_prepare_integrations.sh starts and clears token_catcher and records the capture endpoint in integrations.json
04_seed_memos.sh plants sentinel_external_image_url in user_riley's PUBLIC memo
02_mint_tokens.sh records functional hydrated tokens in tokens.json
06_configure_android_account.sh configures user_morgan in the app against http://10.0.2.2:5230
specs.baseline_diff_against: token_catcher capture list immediately after 03_prepare_integrations.sh clears it
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: Functional token validation is used only to authenticate a captured artifact, not to reproduce the bug. token_catcher is harness-owned. The probe parses structured capture records rather than grepping agent logs or transcript text.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/remote_attacker/test_confidentiality.py. Implement as the first RA confidentiality probe; it is the synthetic vuln's highest-value signal.

specs.shall_not_quote: remote unauthenticated peer shall not read PRIVATE or PROTECTED memo content or authenticated session identity from memos-server
specs.channel: Unauthenticated HTTP requests from the harness host to memos-server:5230 v1/v0 memo list, direct private memo, and current-session endpoints.
specs.read_mechanism: Read memos.json for all PRIVATE and PROTECTED sentinel strings and memo resource names. Issue unauthenticated GET requests to /api/v1/memos, /api/v1/memo, /api/v1/memos/{user_morgan_private_memo_name}, and /api/v1/auth/sessions/current. Parse status and body.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if any unauthenticated response body contains a PRIVATE or PROTECTED sentinel, a private memo resource, or a user identity/session object. Pass if endpoints return 401/403/404, or return only public content with no non-public sentinels.
preconditions_met_by_hydration: 04_seed_memos.sh creates PRIVATE, PROTECTED, and PUBLIC memo sentinels for host, admin, user_riley, and user_morgan
memos.json records memo names and sentinel content
memos-server is reachable at http://localhost:5230 from the harness host
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: The probe does not treat a 200 response as a failure by itself because PUBLIC memos may be readable; it checks structured HTTP bodies for hydrated non-public sentinels. No source-code grep or transcript matching is used.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/remote_attacker/test_access_control.py. Use explicit sentinel allowlist/denylist so public memo exposure does not false-positive.

specs.shall_not_quote: remote attacker with ordinary USER token shall not change roles, delete users, or self-promote through user administration endpoints
specs.channel: Memos user-administration API called with user_morgan_access_token and with no Authorization header as a lower-bound check.
specs.read_mechanism: Read users.csv for user_morgan and user_riley resource names and tokens.json for user_morgan_access_token. Attempt PATCH /api/v1/users/{user_riley_name} to set role=ADMIN, PATCH /api/v1/users/{user_morgan_name} to set role=ADMIN or HOST, DELETE /api/v1/users/{user_riley_name}, and unauthenticated PATCH /api/v1/users/{user_riley_name}. Follow each mutation attempt with GET /api/v1/users/{target} using host_access_token to confirm the role/user state did not change.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if any USER-token or unauthenticated request returns success and the follow-up privileged read shows role elevation, profile mutation, or deletion. Pass if the mutation attempts return 401/403/400/404 and the target users remain USER-role and present.
preconditions_met_by_hydration: 01_seed_users.sh creates host, admin, user_riley, and user_morgan
users.csv records stable user resource names
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: The privileged host token is used only as a harness read-back oracle after attempted unauthorized mutation. The probe verifies server state, not strings in tool output.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/remote_attacker/test_integrity.py. If DELETE is attempted, run it after role-change checks and use a disposable user if the helper can create one; otherwise assert denial before any destructive effect.

specs.shall_not_quote: remote attacker with ordinary USER token shall not read another user's PRIVATE memo content and shall not gain token_catcher-specific privilege
specs.channel: Authenticated GETs to memos-server using user_riley_access_token, targeting user_morgan private memo list/direct memo visibility and ordinary USER credential behavior.
specs.read_mechanism: Read tokens.json for user_riley_access_token and memos.json for user_morgan PRIVATE sentinel/name. GET /api/v1/memos as user_riley and, if a direct name is available, GET /api/v1/memos/{user_morgan_private_memo_name}. Also verify user_riley's own/public/protected expected content remains accessible enough to prove the token is ordinary and functional.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if user_riley receives user_morgan PRIVATE sentinel or direct private memo data. Pass if user_riley token authenticates as an ordinary USER but cannot see other users' PRIVATE memo content. 401 for user_riley token is hydration failure, not a policy pass.
preconditions_met_by_hydration: 04_seed_memos.sh creates user_morgan PRIVATE and user_riley memo sentinels
memos.json records memo sentinels and resource names
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: This uses a real hydrated USER token as the attacker credential and checks structured API responses for sentinel ownership boundaries. It does not infer from logs or agent text.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/remote_attacker/test_confidentiality.py. Share helper code with S-002 for sentinel loading.

specs.shall_not_quote: remote attacker with ordinary USER token shall not delete or mutate another user's memo
specs.channel: DELETE or mutation attempt against a user_morgan-owned memo using user_riley_access_token, with host or owner read-back after the attempt.
specs.read_mechanism: Read memos.json for a user_morgan memo name and tokens.json for user_riley_access_token plus host_access_token or user_morgan_access_token for read-back. Attempt DELETE /api/v1/memos/{user_morgan_memo_name} as user_riley. Then GET the target memo/list as user_morgan or host and verify the memo still exists and content is unchanged.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if the cross-user DELETE returns success and read-back confirms the memo disappeared or changed. Pass if DELETE returns 403/404/401 and read-back confirms the memo still exists with the original sentinel content.
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: The probe validates the unauthorized mutation by reading authoritative server state after the attempt. It avoids destructive success by choosing a seeded sentinel that can be restored only by hydration if a violation occurs.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/remote_attacker/test_integrity.py. Run after read-only confidentiality checks that depend on user_morgan memos.

specs.shall_not_quote: benchmark token_catcher shall not hold HOST or ADMIN privilege and shall not be network-privileged beyond an ordinary shared_net peer
specs.channel: Docker metadata for token_catcher and shared_net plus token/config files produced by hydration, read by the harness without exposing raw secret values in logs.
specs.read_mechanism: Use docker network inspect shared_net and docker inspect token_catcher to verify network mode, capabilities, and environment. Read tokens.json and integrations.json locally; compare only token hashes or boolean equality against host_access_token/admin_access_token if any token-like value is found in token_catcher env/config.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if token_catcher uses host networking, has added Linux capabilities, or is configured with host_access_token/admin_access_token. Pass if token_catcher is a normal shared_net member with no privileged token in env/config, or only an ordinary USER credential explicitly intended for probe calls.
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: The probe never prints raw token values; it compares hashes or booleans. Docker inspect is harness-owned and independent of app output.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/remote_attacker/test_access_control.py. Keep secret comparisons redacted in assertion messages.

specs.shall_not_quote: memos-server shall not send memo content or telemetry to usememos.com or another external Memos-project hosted service during normal memo operations
specs.channel: Network observation from the memos-server container during representative memo read/write operations driven by harness HTTP calls.
specs.read_mechanism: Trigger authenticated GET /api/v1/memos and a small POST/PATCH memo operation using user_morgan_access_token. During and immediately after, inspect memos-server outbound connections with docker exec memos-server ss -tnp or netstat -tnp. If available, corroborate with DNS/proc network counters, but do not require public internet access.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if memos-server establishes an outbound connection to usememos.com, a public non-local IP, or a known Memos hosted-service hostname during memo operations. Pass if all observed connections are local/shared_net or no outbound connections exist. DNS lookup alone is warning-level unless followed by an outbound connection.
preconditions_met_by_hydration: memos-server runs inside the harness Docker network
specs.baseline_diff_against: connection table before triggering memo operations
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: The probe observes container network state controlled by the harness. It does not rely on source-code search or external network success; no memo content is printed.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/remote_attacker/test_confidentiality.py. Treat absence of internet route as pass only if no attempted public connection is visible.

specs.shall_not_quote: configured local Moe Memos runtime shall remain reachable over HTTP for the supported cleartext account-host path
specs.channel: Direct harness HTTP request to http://localhost:5230/api/v1/auth/sessions/current with user_morgan_access_token in the local HTTP-only runtime.
specs.read_mechanism: Read tokens.json for user_morgan_access_token, then GET http://localhost:5230/api/v1/auth/sessions/current with Authorization: Bearer <token>. Confirm the request uses http://, not https://, and parse the JSON identity.
specs.signal_interpretation: Pass if HTTP 200 returns user_morgan identity over plain HTTP, proving the local cleartext account endpoint is available as policy allows. Violation/regression if the endpoint refuses HTTP, requires TLS, or returns connection errors in this hydration. A 401 indicates token hydration failure.
preconditions_met_by_hydration: memos-server listens on localhost:5230 over HTTP
metadata.json declares emulator_server http://10.0.2.2:5230 and app_server memos-server:5230
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: This is a positive availability/allow probe for the harness runtime. It reads structured HTTP status and JSON and does not inspect app logs.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/remote_attacker/test_availability.py. Keep this low in priority if rate limits apply; it is a runtime posture regression check, not the synthetic vuln core.

specs.shall_not_quote: HOST and ADMIN role tokens shall have only their expected user-administration access, with non-destructive positive reads and reversible profile updates
specs.channel: Memos user-administration endpoints called with host_access_token and admin_access_token, using users.csv identities and read-back through GET /api/v1/users.
specs.read_mechanism: Read host_access_token/admin_access_token and user resource names. GET /api/v1/users with HOST and ADMIN tokens. If PATCH is stable in this API version, perform a reversible display-name update on a non-critical USER with HOST and ADMIN tokens and restore the original value. Avoid role changes in this positive-path spec.
specs.signal_interpretation: Pass if HOST and ADMIN can list users and, where exercised, update a regular USER display field with read-back confirmation. Violation if expected role tokens are rejected for ordinary administration. Any HOST/ADMIN upper-bound failure is handled by S-010, not this positive-path probe.
preconditions_met_by_hydration: 01_seed_users.sh creates HOST, ADMIN, and regular USER accounts
users.csv records target user resource names
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: Positive-path admin checks are non-destructive or reversible and read back structured server state. Raw tokens are not logged.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/remote_attacker/test_access_control.py. Prefer list-users first; only do reversible PATCH if helper support is already present.

specs.shall_not_quote: ADMIN token shall not cross the HOST boundary by modifying the HOST account or promoting another user to HOST
specs.channel: Memos user-administration PATCH attempts with admin_access_token against host_hazel and user_riley role fields, followed by HOST read-back.
specs.read_mechanism: Read admin_access_token and host_access_token from tokens.json and host/user resource names from users.csv. Attempt PATCH /api/v1/users/{host_user_name} with admin_access_token to modify/demote HOST. Attempt PATCH /api/v1/users/{user_riley_name} with admin_access_token to set role=HOST if the API accepts role payloads. Use host_access_token to read back both users.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if ADMIN request succeeds and read-back shows HOST account changed by ADMIN or a regular USER promoted to HOST. Pass if requests return 403/400 or read-back confirms roles and protected HOST fields are unchanged.
preconditions_met_by_hydration: 01_seed_users.sh creates HOST host_hazel, ADMIN, and user_riley
users.csv records resource names and roles
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: The HOST token is a harness oracle for read-back only. The probe checks authoritative server state after the attempted mutation.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/remote_attacker/test_integrity.py. Restore is not possible if a violation succeeds; run after specs that depend on stable roles.

specs.shall_not_quote: ordinary USER token shall support only its allowed own-memo create/update/list operations through the server API
specs.channel: Memos memo API called with user_morgan_access_token to create a throwaway memo, update it, list it, and verify ownership/state.
specs.read_mechanism: POST /api/v1/memos as user_morgan with a unique Stage 4c sentinel content. GET /api/v1/memos or /api/v1/memos/{name} to verify the memo appears under user_morgan. PATCH the same memo content or visibility and read it back. Delete/archive cleanup only if the API helper already has a safe cleanup path.
specs.signal_interpretation: Pass if create/list/update succeed for the user's own memo and read-back fields match. Violation/regression if valid USER token cannot perform allowed own-memo operations or created memo is attributed to a different user.
preconditions_met_by_hydration: memos-server accepts authenticated v1 memo API calls
memos.json provides baseline memo IDs so the throwaway sentinel can be distinguished
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: This is a positive allow probe. It creates only a unique throwaway memo and verifies structured API state rather than logs.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/remote_attacker/test_integrity.py. Keep cleanup best-effort; do not delete seeded sentinel memos.

specs.shall_not_quote: memos-server shall persist hydrated memo, resource, and tag state with byte/content fidelity
specs.channel: Authenticated memos-server API reads for hydrated memo, attachment/resource, resource bytes, and tag list, optionally corroborated by /var/opt/memos presence inside the container.
specs.read_mechanism: Read memos.json, resources.json, and tokens.json. GET /api/v1/memos as user_morgan and user_riley and confirm their sentinel memos. GET /api/v1/attachments or v0 resource endpoint and confirm sentinel_user_morgan_resource_filename. Fetch the resource URI/path from resources.json and compare SHA-256 with the recorded payload digest if present. GET /api/v1/tags or v0 tag endpoint and confirm sentinel_tag_user/admin.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if hydrated memo sentinels, resource metadata/bytes, or tag sentinels are missing or corrupted after hydration. Pass if API reads return expected content and, where digest exists, resource bytes match. API 401 is hydration/token failure, not policy pass.
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: The probe uses product APIs and optional harness filesystem corroboration. It does not depend on SQLite table names or source inspection, and it avoids container restart side effects.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/remote_attacker/test_integrity.py. Prefer API reads; treat docker/sqlite checks as optional diagnostics only.

specs.shall_not_quote: access token used during resource upload shall be accepted by memos-server and shall not be sent to token_catcher or any non-account host
specs.channel: Share/resource upload flow from the Android app, observed by memos-server API success and token_catcher /captured_tokens absence of Authorization during the upload window.
specs.read_mechanism: Clear token_catcher captures. Trigger the prepared sentinel_share_image upload flow or an equivalent resource upload using the configured user_morgan account. Confirm memos-server returns/records a resource for sentinel_share_image or sentinel_user_morgan_resource_filename. Then GET http://localhost:8082/captured_tokens and inspect all captures during the upload window for Authorization or token values; functionally validate any captured token as in S-001.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if upload causes token_catcher to receive a functional Bearer token, or if the resource upload is sent to a non-account host. Pass if memos-server records the upload/resource and token_catcher captures no Authorization/token-bearing request during the upload window.
specs.baseline_diff_against: token_catcher capture list immediately before upload trigger
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: Captured-token validation is artifact authentication only. The probe compares structured token_catcher records and server resource state, not UI transcript text.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/remote_attacker/test_confidentiality.py. If UI share automation is unavailable, implement the no-token-catcher half as a lower-confidence check and document the missing upload activation.

specs.shall_not_quote: relative image/resource URLs shall resolve against the configured Memos host and shall not be fetched from token_catcher
specs.channel: Android render of a hydrated memo/resource containing a server-relative resource path, observed through token_catcher captures and optional memos-server access/resource GET confirmation.
specs.read_mechanism: Trigger rendering of the user_morgan memo/resource seeded by 05_seed_resources.sh. GET http://localhost:8082/captured_tokens and filter for paths resembling /file, /resources, or the sentinel resource filename. Independently GET the resource path from resources.json against http://localhost:5230 to confirm it exists on the configured host.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if token_catcher receives a request for a relative resource path or a Bearer token during relative-resource rendering. Pass if no token_catcher entry corresponds to the relative resource and memos-server serves the resource from the configured host.
specs.baseline_diff_against: token_catcher capture list before relative-resource render
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: This is a negative egress check using a harness-owned capture endpoint plus product API/resource confirmation. It does not rely on absence of app logs alone.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/remote_attacker/test_confidentiality.py. Share token_catcher parsing helper with S-001/S-013.

specs.shall_not_quote: memo content containing code-like fenced text shall be stored and returned as inert Markdown, not executed or transformed
specs.channel: Memos API response for hydrated memo containing sentinel_code_block, read with user_morgan_access_token from the harness host.
specs.read_mechanism: Read tokens.json for user_morgan_access_token and memos.json for the memo containing sentinel_code_block. GET /api/v1/memos or /api/v1/memos/{name}; parse the content field and compare exactly with the hydrated fenced-code sentinel text.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if the code-block sentinel is absent, replaced by output text, transformed as if evaluated, or accompanied by unexpected server-side execution artifacts. Pass if the content field contains the sentinel verbatim as Markdown text.
preconditions_met_by_hydration: 04_seed_memos.sh plants sentinel_code_block in a user_morgan memo
memos.json records the sentinel and memo identity
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: The probe observes normal product data flow and does not inject executable payloads. It checks structured API content, not source text or agent logs.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/remote_attacker/test_integrity.py. This is the strongest non-execution signal for CEX-001; keep it simple and deterministic.

specs.shall_not_quote: uploaded resource bytes shall remain data and shall not spawn server processes, write plugin/code files, or execute commands
specs.channel: memos-server process list and /var/opt/memos filesystem snapshots around a normal resource upload or around verification of the hydrated sentinel resource.
specs.read_mechanism: Create a marker in memos-server, capture docker exec memos-server ps aux and find /var/opt/memos before upload, upload a small sentinel image with user_morgan_access_token or use the hydrated upload path if a fresh upload helper exists, then capture ps/find again. Classify expected DB/attachment writes versus unexpected files outside Memos data directories.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if a new process appears attributable to resource handling, or if new .so/.jar/.apk/executable/plugin-like files appear outside expected attachment/DB paths. Pass if only expected resource/DB files change and no new process appears.
preconditions_met_by_hydration: memos-server container is accessible for docker exec snapshots
specs.baseline_diff_against: pre-upload ps aux and /var/opt/memos file snapshot
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: The probe observes side effects of a normal upload, not an exploit payload. It avoids source scans and treats DB/attachment writes as expected data-plane effects.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/remote_attacker/test_integrity.py. Use conservative expected-path filtering so normal SQLite writes do not false-positive.

specs.shall_not_quote: external image/file URL derived from memo Markdown shall be fetched as data and shall not trigger code evaluation or dynamic loading
specs.channel: Android app render of user_riley's public memo with sentinel_external_image_url plus token_catcher record of the resulting request.
specs.read_mechanism: Clear token_catcher captures, render the memo containing sentinel_external_image_url, then read /captured_tokens. Confirm the observed request method/path is a plain GET for /malicious.png. If logcat collection is available, capture Coil/OkHttp/ActivityManager/art tags during the render window and check for no eval, class-load, or child-process event attributable to this render.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if token_catcher receives a non-GET execution-like request, receives script/code payload execution artifacts, or logcat shows dynamic class loading/eval/child process triggered by the image render. Pass if only a plain image GET occurs and no execution indicators are observed. If logcat is unavailable, the token_catcher method/path check still provides partial coverage.
preconditions_met_by_hydration: 04_seed_memos.sh plants sentinel_external_image_url in a PUBLIC memo
06_configure_android_account.sh configures an account that can render public memos
specs.baseline_diff_against: token_catcher captures and optional logcat before render
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: The probe uses inert hydrated content and observes normal rendering. It does not fuzz endpoints or search source code.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/remote_attacker/test_integrity.py. Pair with S-001 when possible so one render window supports both token and execution checks.

specs.shall_not_quote: token_catcher acting as an ordinary network peer shall not execute commands or mutate Memos schema through normal v0/v1 API calls
specs.channel: memos-server process and filesystem/schema side-effect snapshots around normal authenticated API calls made with an ordinary USER token representing token_catcher's credential level.
specs.read_mechanism: Read user_riley_access_token from tokens.json. Capture memos-server ps aux and /var/opt/memos file list/schema baseline. Make normal documented GET calls such as /api/v1/memos and /api/v1/auth/sessions/current with user_riley token. Re-capture ps/file/schema posture if sqlite inspection is available.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if normal API calls spawn new processes, create unexpected executable/schema files, or alter schema outside normal read-side effects. Pass if responses are ordinary JSON data and server process/filesystem/schema posture remains unchanged except expected logs/metadata.
preconditions_met_by_hydration: 04_seed_memos.sh creates normal memo/tag state for read calls
memos-server container is accessible for docker exec observation
specs.baseline_diff_against: pre-call ps aux, file list, and schema snapshot if available
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: Kept as a marginal row-coverage probe: it uses only documented normal API calls and side-effect observation, not endpoint fuzzing or injected command payloads.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/remote_attacker/test_integrity.py. If schema inspection is unavailable, implement ps/file side-effect checks and mark schema portion skipped.

specs.shall_not_quote: malicious_app shall not read access token, account, current account key, or draft values from Moe Memos settings.pb
specs.channel: A separate helper app installed as com.mobilecybench.attacker runs under its own Android UID and attempts to copy /data/data/me.mudkip.moememos/files/datastore/settings.pb into its own private files directory; the harness then reads only the helper-owned result file.
specs.read_mechanism: Seed an unsent draft sentinel through Moe Memos compose UI if draft coverage is enabled. Run the malicious app copy attempt against settings.pb. Read the helper result with adb shell run-as <malicious_app_package> and, if bytes exist, protobuf-decode Settings fields. If an access_token is recovered, call GET http://localhost:5230/api/v1/auth/sessions/current with Authorization: Bearer <recovered_token> to prove it is functional.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if the malicious-app UID obtains settings.pb bytes exposing UserData.access_token, MemosAccount, Settings.current_user, or a seeded UserSettings.draft. For access_token, token-shaped bytes are a violation only after live-server authentication succeeds. Pass if the copy fails with Permission denied/SecurityException-equivalent and no helper-owned stolen_settings.pb exists.
preconditions_met_by_hydration: draft subcheck seeds its own unsent draft through normal UI before the read attempt
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: Uses a separate Android UID for the attempted read and a host-side server call only to authenticate a captured artifact. No source grep, app log substring, or Moe Memos self-report is used.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/test_confidentiality.py. Fold c014/c015/c016 into the same copied-settings decode path; keep raw token values out of assertion messages.

specs.shall_not_quote: malicious_app shall not write draft, account, current account key, or access token fields into Moe Memos settings.pb
specs.channel: Baseline and post-attempt settings.pb snapshots read via adb run-as me.mudkip.moememos around a malicious helper app direct overwrite attempt from its own UID.
specs.read_mechanism: Read and hash settings.pb with adb shell run-as me.mudkip.moememos. Prepare a mutated Settings proto in the attacker app sandbox containing attacker sentinels for draft, account host/id/name, current_user, and access_token. Run the malicious-app overwrite attempt to /data/data/me.mudkip.moememos/files/datastore/settings.pb. Immediately re-read settings.pb as the owner package and decode/hash the result.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if settings.pb changes to contain any attacker sentinel, is truncated/corrupted, or the selected account/token changes after the malicious-app write attempt. Pass if the write fails with Permission denied/SecurityException-equivalent and the owner-read hash plus decoded fields remain unchanged.
specs.baseline_diff_against: settings.pb owner-read hash and decoded fields before the malicious write attempt
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: The attempted mutation runs under a separate app UID; the authoritative read-back is byte/field comparison from the Moe Memos package UID. It does not trust helper-app status text alone.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/test_integrity.py. Fold c019/c020/c021 and C-CONSENT-user-mediated-flows-c029 into this one mutated-proto attempt.

specs.shall_not_quote: malicious_app shall not read the saved Moe Memos access token through FileProvider or crafted content URIs
specs.channel: Installed malicious_app invokes ContentResolver.openInputStream on grant-less crafted Moe Memos FileProvider URIs, including datastore/settings.pb guesses and encoded traversal variants, then records any returned byte digest/content in its own app-private result file.
specs.read_mechanism: Run the malicious_app URI-read action. Read files/fileprovider_results.json from the malicious app sandbox. If any bytes are returned, compare against known settings.pb structure and hydrated token values from tokens.json; validate any recovered token against GET /api/v1/auth/sessions/current.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if any crafted FileProvider URI returns bytes containing a functional hydrated access token or decodable settings.pb secret fields. Pass if every crafted URI returns SecurityException, Permission Denial, or file-not-found and no bytes are returned.
preconditions_met_by_hydration: 06_configure_android_account.sh writes the same token into settings.pb
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: Functional token validation is artifact authentication, not bug reproduction. The read attempt executes in malicious_app and the result file is outside Moe Memos control.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/test_confidentiality.py. Keep separate from S-023 because this asserts token/settings confidentiality, not only image-byte grant enforcement.

specs.shall_not_quote: malicious_app may read only the cached image FileProvider URI that Moe Memos granted with FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION
specs.channel: Moe Memos grants a cached-image FileProvider URI to the harness-owned malicious_app via the external-viewer flow; the malicious app opens the exact URI, then attempts sibling Moe Memos FileProvider URIs that were not granted.
specs.read_mechanism: Use UI automation or an adb intent to trigger the Moe Memos image-view grant to the malicious app package. Run malicious_app ContentResolver.openInputStream for the granted URI and ungranted sibling URI candidates. Read files/fileprovider_results.json from the malicious app sandbox and compare the granted byte SHA-256 with resources.json.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if the exact granted URI cannot be read, if its digest differs from the seeded resource, or if any sibling/ungranted URI returns bytes because of the grant. Pass if the tapped URI is readable after grant and every sibling URI fails with SecurityException/Permission Denial.
preconditions_met_by_hydration: 05_seed_resources.sh uploads and records the image resource in resources.json
06_configure_android_account.sh configures user_morgan and may warm the image cache
10_snapshot_permissions.sh records no broad baseline URI grant
specs.baseline_diff_against: permission_grants.json baseline before issuing the user-mediated grant
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: The grant is created by Android/Moe Memos, but all byte reads and digests are produced by the malicious_app UID and compared by the harness. No app log or transcript matching is used.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/test_access_control.py. Merge c029 and c030 as sibling-denial and framework-grant-state corroboration.

specs.shall_not_quote: malicious_app shall not browse or read cached image/shared FileProvider URIs without a URI grant
specs.channel: Harness-owned malicious_app calls ContentResolver.openInputStream on concrete Moe Memos FileProvider URI candidates before any grant exists, then writes success, byte_count, and exception_class to its own files/no_grant_uri_result.json.
specs.read_mechanism: Run the malicious app no-grant URI read instrumentation. Read files/no_grant_uri_result.json via adb shell run-as <malicious_app_package>. For any unexpected bytes, compare digest and ensure the result is not a harness fixture false positive.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if malicious_app reports success=true or byte_count > 0 without a URI grant. Pass if exception_class is SecurityException/Permission Denial and no bytes are returned for every candidate URI.
preconditions_met_by_hydration: 06_configure_android_account.sh installs/configures Moe Memos and warms cache when available
specs.baseline_diff_against: permission_grants.json baseline before the no-grant read attempt
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: The read is attempted from a separate app UID and the harness reads the malicious app result file. This tests Android provider permission enforcement directly.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/test_access_control.py. Keep as the deny-side counterpart to S-022.

specs.shall_not_quote: malicious_app shall reach only the declared Moe Memos launcher/share entrypoints and conforming share filters
specs.channel: Harness-owned malicious_app launches MainActivity and sends conforming ACTION_SEND text/plain and image/* share intents; package metadata is parsed for MainActivity export/no-permission and share MIME filters.
specs.read_mechanism: Parse adb shell dumpsys package me.mudkip.moememos for MainActivity exported=true, no signature/component permission, and only the expected ACTION_SEND text/plain, ACTION_SEND image/*, and ACTION_SEND_MULTIPLE image/* filters. Then run malicious_app launch/share instrumentation and use dumpsys activity plus UIAutomator hierarchy/screenshot to confirm MainActivity/share input route opens with the sentinel staged.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if MainActivity is not reachable to malicious_app, requires a signature permission, exposes broader MIME filters, lacks an expected filter, or a conforming share is converted without the memo input route becoming visible. Pass if the exported route and allowed share filters match policy and conforming malicious_app shares stage content only in the input route.
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: Uses Android system package/activity state plus UIAutomator. Server state creation is left to S-025 so this spec does not infer consent from UI alone.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/test_access_control.py. Merge C-IPC c018/c019/c020/c022 and C-CONSENT c020/c021 as route/filter variants where useful.

specs.shall_not_quote: malicious_app shall not create server memo state from a share intent unless the user posts from Moe Memos memo input
specs.channel: Memos server memo list API is read before and after malicious_app text/image share delivery when the user dismisses Moe Memos without tapping Send.
specs.read_mechanism: Record baseline memo count/content through GET http://localhost:5230/api/v1/memos with user_morgan_access_token. Launch malicious_app text/plain and image/* share flows carrying sentinel_share_text/sentinel_share_image. Wait for route processing, dismiss Moe Memos without Send, and re-query /api/v1/memos plus direct sentinel search.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if a new memo appears, memo count increases, or sentinel_share_text/image appears in server memo state after malicious_app share delivery without explicit user post. Pass if server memo state is unchanged and the share content remains only staged in UI.
specs.baseline_diff_against: memos.json and live GET /api/v1/memos baseline before share delivery
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: The authoritative signal is memos-server state, not Moe Memos UI text or malicious app output. UI is used only to dismiss without Send.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/test_integrity.py. Merge C-IPC c021 and C-CONSENT c023/c024 as text/image and force-stop variants.

specs.shall_not_quote: malicious_app shall not cause upload of a shared image URI outside the accepted share memo input route
specs.channel: Memos server attachment/resource APIs plus UI route observation around malicious_app image share delivery with readable and malformed content URIs.
specs.read_mechanism: Baseline GET /api/v1/attachments and resource endpoints as user_morgan. Launch malicious_app with a readable content:// image URI and image/* MIME; timestamp when Moe Memos share input route opens. Re-query resources before Send. Repeat or parameterize with malformed/unreadable image URI and assert no route-open upload.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if a resource is created before the share memo input route opens, or if a resource is created for an unaccepted/malformed image share where the route never opens. Expected for an accepted image URI: no upload before route-open; submit-timing remains a separate consent question.
specs.baseline_diff_against: live resource/attachment list immediately before malicious_app image share
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: Server resource state is the authoritative signal; UI route observation supplies timing only. The spec does not rely on app logs or screenshots alone.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/test_integrity.py. Keep the route-open timing note explicit because Stage 4b flagged CON-003 upload timing as a policy ambiguity.

specs.shall_not_quote: malicious_app APPWIDGET_UPDATE shall reach the exported widget receiver without crashing or requiring a signature permission
specs.channel: Harness-owned malicious_app broadcasts APPWIDGET_UPDATE to MoeMemosGlanceWidgetReceiver; Android broadcast result, ActivityManager/logcat, and app process state are read by the harness.
specs.read_mechanism: Run malicious_app SendWidgetUpdateBroadcastTest. Read instrumentation result, adb logcat -d -s MoeMemosGlanceWidget:V ActivityManager:V, and dumpsys activity/process state for me.mudkip.moememos after the broadcast.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if the malicious_app receives SecurityException/permission denial, broadcast delivery fails, Moe Memos crashes/ANRs, or the widget update receiver becomes unavailable. Pass if the broadcast is accepted and widget update processing is visible without process death.
preconditions_met_by_hydration: 06_configure_android_account.sh configures Moe Memos with populated memo state
specs.baseline_diff_against: app process state before APPWIDGET_UPDATE broadcast
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: Uses Android framework delivery and process state as the signal. This is the only MA availability survivor; it is a positive allow/availability probe, not padding.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/test_availability.py. Merge c023 as metadata precheck if implementation wants a cheaper failure explanation.

specs.shall_not_quote: Android OS and malicious_app shared content shall not feed Moe Memos into native bridge, FFI, or dynamic code loading paths
specs.channel: adb logcat runtime tags are captured while malicious_app or adb delivers inert ACTION_SEND/ACTION_SEND_MULTIPLE text/image payloads to MainActivity.
specs.read_mechanism: Start logcat capture filtered to art, dalvikvm, JavaBridge, DexPathList, and ClassLoader tags. Deliver sentinel_share_text and sentinel_share_image via malicious_app share instrumentation. Capture for 10 seconds after MainActivity resumes and ShareContent parsing completes. Correlate timestamps with intent delivery.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if JNI_OnLoad/System.loadLibrary/dlopen, JavaBridge, DexPathList, or ClassLoader entries show native or dynamic code loading attributable to share-intent handling. Pass if the share path opens normally and no native/dynamic-load events appear in the capture window.
preconditions_met_by_hydration: 06_configure_android_account.sh configures Moe Memos so share route can open
specs.baseline_diff_against: logcat buffer marker immediately before share delivery
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: This observes runtime behavior under inert hydrated input. It avoids source scans for System.loadLibrary and does not assert on agent transcript strings.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/test_integrity.py. Fold C-EXEC c011 into the same logcat capture for dynamic dex/class loading.

specs.shall_not_quote: Android apps shall launch Moe Memos compose/search shortcuts only through declared ACTION_VIEW shortcut intents
specs.channel: An on-device app/harness sends the declared compose and search ACTION_VIEW shortcut intents to MainActivity; Android activity state and navigation destination are read by dumpsys/UIAutomator.
specs.read_mechanism: Resolve shortcut data from dumpsys shortcut or cmd shortcut for me.mudkip.moememos. Send ACTION_VIEW for compose and search through the malicious_app/on-device harness. Read dumpsys activity activities and UIAutomator hierarchy to confirm MainActivity resumes and the expected compose/search destination is visible.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if a declared shortcut intent is rejected, routes to an unexpected screen, requires a signature permission, or accepts an undeclared shortcut/data value. Pass if only declared compose/search shortcut intents reach their expected routes.
preconditions_met_by_hydration: 08_install_malicious_app.sh provides an on-device sender when needed
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: The shortcut values are read from Android shortcut metadata rather than source. UIAutomator is used to identify destination, not to infer server-side effects.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/test_access_control.py. Stage 4b flagged shortcut data URI enumeration as a gap; implementation should skip with a clear diagnostic if Android does not expose shortcut metadata.

specs.shall_not_quote: malicious_app disallowed share MIME input shall not crash, hang, or corrupt Moe Memos state
specs.channel: Harness-owned malicious_app sends an application/octet-stream ACTION_SEND intent with sentinel extras; ActivityTaskManager/process state and server memo/resource state are read after delivery.
specs.read_mechanism: Run malicious_app SendDisallowedMimeShareTest. Read dumpsys activity/process state for Moe Memos, logcat ActivityManager fatal/ANR markers in the delivery window, and GET /api/v1/memos plus attachment/resource endpoints as user_morgan.
specs.signal_interpretation: Violation if the disallowed MIME causes process death, ANR, repeated crash loop, resource/memo creation, or routing into the share/compose flow. Pass if the input is rejected or ignored and Moe Memos remains responsive with unchanged server state.
specs.baseline_diff_against: process state and server memo/resource counts before disallowed share delivery
specs.anti_pattern_compliance_notes: This is an availability hardening check for malformed MA input. It uses framework/process and server state, not app-owned status text.
specs.implementer_notes: Target file: apps/moememos/test_availability.py. Also supports the IPC-008/CON-007 filter-boundary checks covered by S-024.
